text: The wife lodged an FIR under Section 498A IPC alleging that her husband and mother-in-law subjected her to cruelty and repeated dowry demands after the marriage.
During the partition dispute, the younger brother was booked under Sections 467 and 471 IPC for forging the father's will to claim a larger share.
The husband was prosecuted under Section 494 IPC for contracting a second marriage during the subsistence of the first.
The father was booked for kidnapping his own minor child from lawful guardianship in violation of the custody order, under Section 361 IPC.
The accused was charged with criminal trespass after forcibly entering his estranged wife's residence in violation of the restraining order.
The husband was charged with theft under Section 379 IPC for removing his wife's personal belongings from the shared residence.
The police filed charges of unlawful assembly against the in-laws who gathered to forcibly evict the daughter-in-law.
The accused was charged with abetting the suicide of his daughter-in-law following sustained harassment at the matrimonial home.
